questions.question: What are the top 3 artists with the largest number of songs in the language Bangla?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.artist_name FROM artist AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.artist_name  =  T2.artist_name WHERE T2.languages  =  "bangla" GROUP BY T2.artist_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Find the top 3 artists who have the largest number of songs works whose language is Bangla.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.artist_name FROM artist AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.artist_name  =  T2.artist_name WHERE T2.languages  =  "bangla" GROUP BY T2.artist_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: which gender got the highest average uncertain ratio.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t1.sex FROM people AS t1 JOIN candidate AS t2 ON t1.people_id  =  t2.people_id GROUP BY t1.sex ORDER BY avg(t2.unsure_rate) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the top three apartment types in terms of the average room count? Give me the
questions.gold_sql: SELECT apt_type_code FROM Apartments GROUP BY apt_type_code ORDER BY avg(room_count) DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Show the top 3 apartment type codes sorted by the average number of rooms in descending order.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT apt_type_code FROM Apartments GROUP BY apt_type_code ORDER BY avg(room_count) DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Show the most common nationality of pilots.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Nationality FROM pilot GROUP BY Nationality ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the details for the projects which were launched by the organization with the most projects?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT project_details FROM Projects WHERE organisation_id IN ( SELECT organisation_id FROM Projects GROUP BY organisation_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1 )

questions.question: Which projects have no outcome? List the project details.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT project_details FROM Projects WHERE project_id NOT IN ( SELECT project_id FROM Project_outcomes )

questions.question: List three countries which are the origins of the least players.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT birth_country FROM player GROUP BY birth_country ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 3;

questions.question: What is the country that has the most perpetrators?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Country ,  COUNT(*) FROM perpetrator GROUP BY Country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the most frequent status of bookings?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Status_Code FROM BOOKINGS GROUP BY Status_Code ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
